summary: Welltower Inc. filed an 8-K on July 28, 2026, disclosing a new at-the-market (ATM) equity distribution agreement allowing issuance of up to $7.5 billion of common stock through multiple sales agents, with optional forward sale agreements. The company terminated its prior ATM agreement dated October 28, 2025. This is a capital-raising facility, not a buyback or special distribution. The forward sale mechanics allow for potential share settlement flexibility. What to watch: actual issuance pace and use of proceeds, which could signal capital deployment for acquisitions or balance sheet management. The filing is routine, but the scale ($7.5B) is notable; risk-arb angle is limited as it is not an M&A event.
